response.description:
VNet Flow Log captures IP
traffic flowing through VNets, Subnets, & NICs for monitoring, troubleshooting,
network optimization, security, and compliance needs. This release introduces advanced filtering
capabilities in VNet Flow Logs, empowering users with unprecedented granular
control over network traffic logging. With support for nine distinct criteria including
IP addresses, ports, protocols, encryption state, allowed/denied actions, flow
states, and traffic directions.  This empowers organization to surgically capture only
the traffic that truly matters most to their operations. This flexibility
enables selective recording of intra/inter-VNet traffic, CIDR-based flows,
inbound/outbound traffic or traffic flowing through specific ports and much more
all through intuitive logical operations of AND and OR.  By prioritizing critical flows and tailoring
monitoring to user preferences, organizations gain faster, more actionable
insights while maintaining robust network visibility This release aids significant operational efficiencies
by dramatically reducing log volume and noise. By targeting only relevant
traffic logs, organizations can streamline troubleshooting, minimize data
processing overhead, and lower total cost of ownership (TCO) through reduced
storage requirements. The simplified log management not only preserves
essential visibility but also ensures compliance and security monitoring remain
uncompromised. environments. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure VNet Flow Log - Filtering
